_comment: Frame-master registry for print-assets:mockups. Copy to frames.json once all six masters exist under gitignored design/print-assets/frames_blanks/. Masters are OPAQUE blanks (baked background + shadow, any canvas ratio); window = the sheet rect as fractions of the master canvas — the sheet is composited OVER it, then centre-cropped to 7:10. Framed windows must match the FAP sheet ratio 0.70, mount windows the CFPM aperture ratio 0.667, within 2% (composeMockup fail-closes otherwise). Framed windows below are MEASURED from the real 1254x1254 blanks (2026-07-20 set: black_wood/natural_wood/dark_wood, window ratios 0.696-0.698 — incl. the re-exported dark_wood_frame replacing the rejected 0.746 brown blank); mount windows are derived starting points assuming the mount masters follow the runbook recipe (aperture 85.7% x 90% of the framed window, centred) — the three mount blanks do not exist yet; re-measure after drawing them.
